posts.title: Man shoots his ex-girlfriend at student apartment near University of Houston, HPD says
posts.description: A woman is fighting for her life after her ex-boyfriend shot her at a student living apartment near the University of Houston on Friday night, police said.

posts.title: It's a little warmer this weekend with another cold front for Sunday
posts.description: After a chilly start Saturday morning, temps soar to the 70s. A cold front will blow through Sunday morning ushering in a stiff breeze and brief cool down for Monday.

posts.title: Postponed NYC Macy's 100th Thanksgiving Day parade gets a do-over with 100 balloons and 1,000 clowns
posts.description: What's 48 hours? Macy's milestone 100th Thanksgiving Day parade is getting a do-over, long after most of the turkey leftovers have been repurposed into sandwiches.
